items.title: Tom Albert Interview, 1962-05-07
items.q: And now Manela, when I brought the horn, we used to play with him, them times.

ctx.x: Did they mix it up then, the musicians? Did they mix it up, the white and colored musicians there?

Well no, they didn't mix it up. They had some fellas you know, you couldn't tell them from whites, you understand. They used to mix up them. Oh, Emmanuel Meletta had his brother there, used to play in the white band. And there were old man and Ulec. Old man Ulec, he used to play corn at the, used to play in the, I don't forget that band, that's the only big band they had in town here then. Old man Ulec, he was the leader. And now Manela, when I brought the horn, we used to play with him, them times. Well now I…
What was Fest's brother's name, do you remember?
